test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All girls are pretty.

X is pretty.

**Conclusions:**

I. X is a girl.

II. All pretty people are girls.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16ff7dca9101f40c57352cc119e14ab2e34bf12bc351f16a853fdf2709c6bf51.png] 

Conclusions:

I. X is a girl → Does not follow (As all girls are pretty and X is pretty. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. All pretty people are girls → Does not follow (As all girls are pretty. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
